**#169 / F112 after-deploy: +0 recorded daemon launches/60.001249 s; ps.tmux-legacy-tap-writer absent in both snapshots.**

Reported merge and canonical checkout: `a2cc5e7087b98a2ed934380e900657b4d26d17ec`. Daemon **PID 80366**, process start **2026-11-08 08:48:06 +10:00**, unchanged across snapshots. The generic `pij-rs 0.1.0` label is not an independently embedded source SHA.

| Measurement | Result |
|---|---|
| Two pings | **08:51:19.096722 to 08:52:19.098279 +10:00** |
| Elapsed | **60.001249 s**, monotonic |
| Recorded launches | **139 to 139: +0, 0.000/s**; all nine populated sites flat |
| F112 census key | **Absent before and after**; no census launches recorded |
| Registration counters | **10 attempts / 14 ps**, unchanged |
| Interval CPU | **8.24 CPU seconds / 60.001249 s = 13.73%** of one CPU |
| RSS | **180.14 to 180.75 MiB**, +624 KiB |
| Machine launches | **22.1/s**, separate niced 20-second sample |

The instrument has populated/reconciled counters (including startup registration and tap attach sites), and F112's earlier +100/min plus the retired-site source guard supply the positive/source controls. This loaded-deployment quiet window is distinct from the prime's earlier manual marker repair; it does not exercise a newly refused foreign pipe or prove all fallback paths are launch-free.

The machine sample attributed **21.9/s** as a lower bound: **16.7/s other**, **5.2/s gone before identification**, no recognized daemon-child contribution. It made **266,242 in-process polls** in 20 seconds; it consumes CPU despite nice priority and overlaps part of the daemon minute. Machine and daemon scopes differ.

Do not subtract totals across the pre/post bounce or attribute CPU/RSS changes solely to F112. No live fault/census, synthetic message, build, test, restart or model canary was run. Both bounded measurement processes completed.

Raw session receipts: `pr169-after-window.json`, `pr169-after-machine.json`. These verify the requested after-reading; legitimate workload attribution and F82's Claude traffic-bearing proof remain separately pending.
